title: OR-Bench: An Over-Refusal Benchmark for Large Language Models

prompt.location: Prompts are the dataset items, no system prompt (Sec. 4.1); refusal keywords and LLM-check prompt in Appendix F

claim.judge: llm:gpt-4 (undated) for refusal detection on the hard subset

notes: Soft gap: refusal detection on the hard subset uses an undated 'GPT-4' check (keyword matching approximates it within ~2%). Hard-1K size is not stated in the text (about 1.3K prompts). Prompts are seemingly toxic but verified safe, so ToS exposure is limited; OR-Bench-Toxic is not needed for this claim.

resolution.plan: Hard-1K is 1,319 prompts (Appendix U), available at huggingface.co/datasets/bench-llm/or-bench; send each as a bare user message (no system prompt, Sec. 4.1) to gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 at temperature 0. Label refusals with the Appendix S judge prompt run on gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09 as the stand-in for the undated 'GPT-4' judge, and cross-check with the Appendix M keyword list. Compare the overall rejection rate with 12.7 (Table 2).
resolution.approximation: Judge model substituted (undated GPT-4 -> gpt-4-turbo-2024-04-09); the paper reports keyword matching agrees with the GPT-4 judge within about 2 points.
